## Goal

Estimate large-scale copy number in an alfalfa mapping population using DArTag genotyping data.

The existing collaborator tutorial is a strong model for long-form technical instruction: it has a clear biological use case, a floating table of contents, visible code, and a complete analysis narrative.

[Open the current full tutorial](https://breeding-insight.github.io/Qploidy2/Qploidy_alfalfa_tutorial.html){.btn-bi-primary}
[Explore Qploidy2](../software/qploidy2.qmd){.btn-bi-secondary}

## Migration recommendation

Convert the source R Markdown to Quarto, keep executable R chunks, and use the shared BI brand file. Preserve the detailed workflow while adding:

- an explicit prerequisites block,
- a workflow map near the top,
- checkpoints after each major modeling stage,
- a short troubleshooting section,
- links to the Qploidy2 package landing page and source repository.
